title: Controllers & Routing
description: Learn about controllers, actions, and convention-based routing in ASP.NET Core.
longDescription: This module teaches you how controllers handle HTTP requests, how action methods process requests, and how routing maps URLs to controller actions. You will also learn about passing data between views and controllers.
whatYouLearn: Understand the role of controllers in ASP.NET Core MVC
Transfer data between views and controllers
Use ViewBag, ViewData, and TempData for data transfer
Implement convention-based routing for SEO-friendly URLs
